comparisons.label: Sentence 1
comparisons.before: I am agree because people is kind.
comparisons.after: I agree because people are kind.
comparisons.grammarIssue: “Agree” is a verb, so it does not take “am.” “People” is plural and takes “are.”
comparisons.grammarExplanation: The corrected sentence follows the standard form shown above.
comparisons.grammarRule: “Agree” is a verb, so it does not take “am.”
comparisons.grammarExample: I agree because people are kind.

metrics.rewritten:
In my view, this question needs to be understood from two different perspectives.

First, we should recognize the possible risks. Any powerful technology can create serious consequences when it is not managed responsibly. Progress therefore needs to be matched by safety and accountability.

At the same time, it can also create valuable opportunities. Used wisely, it may solve existing problems and give society more choices for the future.

Ultimately, the question is not simply whether it represents hope or danger. The real challenge is learning to pursue its benefits while managing its risks responsibly.
